bio: Enter this inviting neighbourhood spot and you’ll soon see the walls filled with natural and low-intervention wines – which are a perfect fit for the relaxed, on-trend vibe and cosy surroundings. Settle in at your table amidst the exposed brickwork and ask the charming team for recommendations on which wines to try, then accompany them with the brilliantly priced cooking. Both the light Neapolitan-style pizzas and the seasonal small plates provide bags of flavour in every mouthful. Bring your friends, order lots and have a simply wonderful time.
